name: Character Randomizer Test
description: SUPERSEDED by the 2026-10-11 playtests - kept because it is the ROM those readings were taken on. randomize_characters with moves="move", which deals individual POW move rows across the cast. It does not do what the name suggests: a move's animation, stylus minigame and hit count are keyed to the character and slot, not to the row, so a dealt move is the slot's own move wearing another move's name, icon, description and status effect. For moveset variety use randomize_characters recruitment instead, which changes the performer. The build is crash-gated now: a support move can no longer land in an offensive slot.
